summary: Nicolas Boucher demonstrates four Anthropic plugins for finance work: Finance for budget variance and reconciliation; Data for messy exports, analysis checks and dashboards; Operations for vendor comparisons; and Legal for contract review. The useful pattern is to start a fresh context for each task, supply relevant inputs, request a structured draft, then check calculations and assumptions against the originals. A sensible future SkillLantern exercise would use synthetic budget-versus-actual data with known totals, followed by a manual reconciliation checklist. Creator speed and accuracy claims are unverified. Contract and reporting outputs need qualified review. This is an operational-finance source, not an investment recommendation or return forecast.
